    """Creates the `length` SOp using selector width primitive."""
    all_true_selector = rasp.Select(
        rasp.tokens, rasp.tokens, rasp.Comparison.TRUE
    ).named("all_true_selector")
    return rasp.SelectorWidth(all_true_selector).named("length")

length = make_length()

def make_cumsum(bools: rasp.SOp) -> rasp.SOp:
    """Returns, at each position, the sum of bools up to and including that position."""
    leq_selector = rasp.Select(rasp.indices, rasp.indices, rasp.Comparison.LEQ)
    return rasp.Aggregate(leq_selector, rasp.numerical(bools), default=0).named("cumsum")

    """Return running balance (opens - closes) at each position."""
    bools_open = sop == open_token
    bools_close = sop == close_token
    opens_cumsum = make_cumsum(bools_open)
    closes_cumsum = make_cumsum(bools_close)
    balance = rasp.SequenceMap(lambda o, c: o - c, opens_cumsum, closes_cumsum).named("pair_balance")
    return balance

    """Returns 1 if a set of parentheses are balanced, 0 else."""
    assert len(pairs) >= 1

    # Compute running balance of each type of parenthesis
    balances = []
    for pair in pairs:
        assert len(pair) == 2
        open_token, close_token = pair
        balance = make_pair_balance(
            rasp.tokens, open_token=open_token, close_token=close_token
        ).named(f"balance_{pair}")
        balances.append(balance)

    # Check if any balance is negative at any position
    any_negative = balances[0] < 0
    for balance in balances[1:]:
        any_negative = any_negative | (balance < 0)

    # Convert to numerical SOp
    any_negative_num = rasp.numerical(any_negative).named("any_negative_num")

    # For each position, aggregate over all positions to see if any negative exists
    select_all = rasp.Select(rasp.indices, rasp.indices, rasp.Comparison.TRUE).named("select_all")
    has_neg = rasp.Aggregate(select_all, any_negative_num, default=0).named("has_neg")

    # For each position, check if all balances are zero at the last position
    # Get last index at each position
    last_idx = rasp.Map(lambda l: l - 1, length).named("last_idx")
    select_last = rasp.Select(rasp.indices, last_idx, rasp.Comparison.EQ).named("select_last")

    # For all balances, check if balance == 0 at last position
    all_zero = balances[0] == 0
    for balance in balances[1:]:
        all_zero = all_zero & (balance == 0)
    # Aggregate to get the value at the last position
    last_zero = rasp.Aggregate(select_last, all_zero, default=0).named("last_zero")

    # Output: True if no negative anywhere and all balances zero at the end
    result = (last_zero & (~has_neg)).named("shuffle_dyck")
    return result

    return make_shuffle_dyck(pairs=["()", "{}"]).named("shuffle_dyck2")

    prefix_selector = rasp.Select(rasp.indices, rasp.indices, rasp.Comparison.LEQ).named("prefix_selector")

    for balance in balances:

        num_true_prevs,

    last_zero = rasp.Aggregate(select_last, all_zero_at_end, default=0)

    # The sequence is balanced iff no negative anywhere and all balances are zero at the end
    is_balanced = (~any_negative) & last_zero

    prevs = rasp.Select(rasp.indices, rasp.indices, rasp.Comparison.LEQ)

    has_neg = rasp.numerical(rasp.Aggregate(select_all, any_negative, default=0)).named(
